summary: Configured node1 with persistent Ubuntu HAProxy and Node.js services. HAProxy serves port 80 and proxies / to loopback Node.js port 3000, returning HTTP 200 with infraset-nodejs.
actions_performed: Installed distribution HAProxy and Node.js packages
Created and enabled the Node.js systemd service
Verified both services are active and enabled
Verified port bindings and end-to-end HTTP response
